answer: In PoA, each identity must lock collateral, making Sybil expansion costly before participation. If k coordinated identities equivocate on the same consensus instance, correlated evidence triggers a quadratic penalty, O(k²), across their bonded escrows rather than isolated linear fines. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the swarm, rapidly eroding replacement capacity. Thus sable credentials, nectar rewards, and zephyr aliases cannot mask coordinated fraud or preserve economic control.
